title: Where else to ask {in}
lead: If your item is not among the notices, ask where it may have been handed in.
leadEmpty: We have not yet found a verified city lost and found office {in}. Here is what works across Ukraine.

railway.title: Trains and stations
railway.text: Ukrzaliznytsia takes lost item requests online: describe the item, the date and the train or station.

bus.title: Buses and minibuses
bus.text: Under the national transport rules, a driver who finds a forgotten item on board writes a report and hands the item to the carrier. So ask the carrier that runs the route.
bus.link: Clause 82 of the Rules, Cabinet resolution No. 176

finder.title: Found someone else’s item
finder.text: If the owner is nowhere to be seen, the law says to report the find to the police or the city council. Something found on transport or inside a building goes to the driver, security or the management.

checked: Contacts checked on {date}. They change, so it is best to call before you go.

kyiv-metro.name: Kyiv Metro lost and found office
kyiv-metro.text: At Dorohozhychi station. Weekdays 8:00–17:00, Fridays until 15:45, break 12:00–12:45.

lviv-bureau.name: Lviv lost and found office
lviv-bureau.text: The city office: items found on trams, trolleybuses and around the city end up here, and finds are posted to its Telegram channel. The phone line works on weekdays 9:00–17:00.

chernivtsi-trolleybus.name: Chernivtsi Trolleybus Company
chernivtsi-trolleybus.text: Items lost on the company’s trolleybuses and buses are traced through an online form: describe the item and leave your phone number, and they will call you if there is a match. Everything found is posted to its Telegram channel.

dnipro-metro.name: Dnipro Metro
dnipro-metro.text: There is no separate lost and found office. Tell the station staff or metro security about a forgotten or lost item.

kharkiv-metro.name: Kharkiv Metro
kharkiv-metro.text: There is no separate lost and found office. Report a forgotten item to the metro staff at the station or to the police.

chernihiv-trolleybus.name: Chernihiv Trolleybus Company
chernihiv-trolleybus.text: Under the operator’s rules, items found on a trolleybus are handed to the inspector, conductor, driver or the dispatcher at the last stop of the route. Ask there.

kyiv-kpt.name: Kyivpastrans
kyiv-kpt.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

kharkiv-transport.name: Kharkiv Electric Transport
kharkiv-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

dnipro-transport.name: Dnipro Electric Transport
dnipro-transport.text: Items found on trams and trolleybuses go to the route’s dispatch office, where they are logged. Ask there.

odesa-transport.name: Odesa Electric Transport
odesa-transport.text: According to the press, finds from trams and trolleybuses are handed out at 1 Vodoprovidna St, where the company’s information centre is.

zaporizhzhia-transport.name: Zaporizhzhia Electric Transport
zaporizhzhia-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

vinnytsia-transport.name: Vinnytsia Transport Company
vinnytsia-transport.text: Drivers hand items found on trams to the dispatchers, so ask the dispatch office for the kind of transport you took.

lutsk-transport.name: Lutsk Electric Transport Company
lutsk-transport.text: Drivers hand items found on trolleybuses to the cash office or the dispatch office. Call the dispatch point.

lutsk-department.name: Lutsk City Council transport department
lutsk-department.text: It does not look for items itself, but from the route number and time of the trip it will tell you which carrier runs it and give you its number. Most bus routes in Lutsk are private.

zhytomyr-transport.name: Zhytomyr Tram and Trolleybus Company
zhytomyr-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

ivano-frankivsk-transport.name: Elektroavtotrans
ivano-frankivsk-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

kropyvnytskyi-bus.name: Kropyvnytskyi city buses
kropyvnytskyi-bus.text: Under the city rules, a bus passenger must tell the driver about forgotten items, documents and valuables. So for something lost on a bus, ask the driver or the route’s carrier.

mykolaiv-transport.name: Mykolaiv Electric Transport
mykolaiv-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

poltava-transport.name: Poltava Electric Transport
poltava-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

rivne-transport.name: Rivne city electric transport
rivne-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

sumy-transport.name: Sumy Elektroavtotrans
sumy-transport.text: Items found on trolleybuses and municipal buses are kept at the depot at 113 Kharkivska St, and finds are posted to the electric transport’s Telegram channel.

ternopil-transport.name: Ternopil Electric Transport
ternopil-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

kherson-transport.name: Kherson city electric transport
kherson-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

khmelnytskyi-transport.name: Khmelnytskyi Electric Transport
khmelnytskyi-transport.text: Drivers hand items found on trolleybuses to the dispatch office, and from there they go to the company’s lost and found.

cherkasy-transport.name: Cherkasy Electric Transport
cherkasy-transport.text: For something left on a tram, trolleybus or city bus, ask the operator: the dispatcher or the driver on the route.

uzhhorod-bus.name: Uzhhorod Municipal Transport
uzhhorod-bus.text: Under the city rules, a passenger who notices forgotten items, documents or money on board must tell the driver at the next stop without touching them. So for something lost, ask the driver or the carrier.
